text: style MapLibre GL style URL JSON string (e.g. basemap_provider()), character vector / list stacked bottom top (e.g. basemap published separate hillshade, base label services). width, height View size CSS pixels. center c(longitude, latitude) view centre. zoom MapLibre zoom (0–22, fractional allowed). bounds Bounds fit instead center/zoom: c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) crs (default EPSG:4326), sf::st_bbox() result, sf / sfc object. crs CRS bounds (anything sf::st_crs() accepts). pixel_ratio Device pixels per CSS pixel. layers Optional layer filter applied every style: plain IDs keep layers, minus-prefixed IDs drop ; * ? wildcards ("-label_*"). See list_layers(). Names match layer style warn. labels TRUE keeps every layer, FALSE drops labels (text icons), "" keeps labels transparent background, stack another map. Catalogue raster basemaps switch label-free label-tiles. features Optional feature filter applied every style: plain names keep features, minus-prefixed names drop , e.g. c("water", "roads") "-buildings". Features: background, water, landcover, parks, buildings, roads, rail, boundaries, places, poi, terrain, (feature column list_layers()). Features layer style belongs warn. auth_token Optional access token tile service. tile_timeout_ms Per-tile HTTP timeout milliseconds. max_tiles Maximum tiles fetched per style. tile_concurrency Parallel tile downloads. fail_on_tile_error Abort failed tile instead leaving empty.
